description: Per-language popularity weights for the popular-weighted Strategy 3 recommendation in PHASE6_REDO ss-find / ss-search aggregators. Calibrated for agentic-coding deployment context (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor users in 2026) using GitHub Octoverse 2025, JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey 2025, gradually.ai Claude Code / Codex 2026 statistics, and the JetBrains April 2026 AI Pulse survey. Distinct from the §7 Stack-Overflow-2024 tier weights in two ways: (1) TypeScript / Python / Rust are S-tier (weight 5) because the Octoverse 2025 data explicitly ties TypeScript's rise to AI-assisted coding reliability; (2) Java / Go / C# / JS sit in A-tier (3) rather than the legacy Stack-Overflow tier-1 (3) — they remain mainstream, but the 2026 agentic-coding distribution skews stronger toward the typed + AI-native trio.
sources: GitHub Octoverse 2025 (TypeScript overtook all in Aug 2025, +66.6% YoY; cite for agent-assisted-coding-favors-typed-languages quote)
JetBrains Developer Ecosystem 2025 + AI Pulse Jan 2026 (Claude Code 18% at-work usage, +6x YoY)
gradually.ai Claude Code / Codex statistics 2026 (Claude Code 46.3M downloads; SWE-Bench Verified benchmarks)
Stack Overflow 2025 (Rust 9-year admiration leader at 72-83%; Python +7pp AI-driven surge)
